news_cards.title: US Ka China Ke Scarborough Shoal Dava Par Virodh
bullets: US Ne China Ko South China Sea Mein Apne Dava Ke Liye Doshi Thahraya Hai, Jismein Scarborough Shoal Bhi Shaamil Hai
Filipino Machhimaron Ko Contested Waters Mein Jaane Se Rokha Gaya Hai, Jo Ek Vivaadit Dava Hai
US Ka Kahna Hai Ki China Ne Nature Reserve Ko Enforce Karke Apne Dava Ko Majboot Kiya Hai

news_cards.title: Rahul Gandhi Ka Modi Sarkar Par Hamla, Berozgaari Ke Aankde
bullets: Rahul Gandhi Ne Berozgaari Ke Aankde Pesh Kiye, Jismein 1000 Mein Se Sirf 12 Logon Ko Permanent Naukri Milti Hai
Rahul Gandhi Ne Yeh Aankde Prayagraj Mein Ek Aayojan Mein Diye
Berozgaari Ek Bada Mudda Hai Jise Sarkar Ko Suljhana Hoga

news_cards.title: SAD Chief Badal Ka Women Quota Aur Delimitation Bill Par Jor
bullets: SAD Chief Badal Ne PM Modi Se Mulakat Ke Baad Women Quota Aur Delimitation Bill Par Jor Diya Hai
Badal Ka Kahna Hai Ki In Bills Ko Jaldi Se Pass Kiya Jaana Chahiye
SAD Chief Badal Ne Isse Pehle BJP Ke Saath Gathbandhan Toda Tha, Lekin Ab Phir Se Gathbandhan Ki Sambhavana Hai

news_cards.title: Punjab Election 2027: SAD Aur BJP Ka Phir Se Gathbandhan
bullets: Sukhbir Singh Badal Aur PM Modi Ki Mulakat Ke Baad Punjab Election 2027 Mein Phir Se Gathbandhan Ki Sambhavana Hai
SAD Aur BJP Ne Pehle Farm Laws Ke Karan Gathbandhan Toda Tha, Lekin Ab Phir Se Gathbandhan Ki Sambhavana Hai
Punjab Election 2027 Mein Yeh Gathbandhan Ek Bada Mudda Ho Sakta Hai

news_cards.title: New York City Mein Pied-à-Terre Tax Par Virodh
bullets: New York City Mein Pied-à-Terre Tax Par Virodh Kiya Ja Raha Hai, Jismein Homeowners Ne Court Mein Case Darj Kiya Hai
Homeowners Ka Kahna Hai Ki Tax Ke Karan Unki Personal Information Par Asar Pad Raha Hai
Pied-à-Terre Tax Ek Naya Tax Hai Jise New York City Mein Lagu Kiya Gaya Hai
